from flask import Blueprint, Response, stream_with_context
from sqlalchemy.orm import joinedload
from .db import session
from .models import Order, Customer
import csv, io

bp = Blueprint("export", __name__")
ORDER_HEADER = ["order_id", "created_at", "customer", "email", "sku", "qty", "price", "total"]
CUSTOMER_HEADER = ["id", "name", "email"]
BATCH = 2000

# Existing orders export logic unchanged
def _rows(account_id):
    q = (session.query(Order)
         .options(joinedload(Order.customer), joinedload(Order.line_items))
         .filter(Order.account_id == account_id)
         .order_by(Order.id)
         .yield_per(BATCH))
    for o in q:
        for li in o.line_items:
            yield [o.id, o.created_at.isoformat(), o.customer.name, o.customer.email,
                   li.sku, li.qty, li.unit_price, li.qty * li.unit_price]

@bp.route("/api/accounts/<int:account_id>/orders.csv")
# Existing export_orders implementation unchanged
# ... (rest of the code)

@bp.route("/api/accounts/<int:account_id>/customers.csv")
def export_customers(account_id):
    def gen():
        buf = io.StringIO(); w = csv.writer(buf, delimiter=';')
        w.writerow(CUSTOMER_HEADER)
        q = (session.query(Customer)
             .filter(Customer.account_id == account_id)
             .order_by(Customer.id)
             .yield_per(BATCH))
        
        for c in q:
            w.writerow([c.id, c.name, c.email])
            if buf.tell() > 64_000:
                yield buf.getvalue(); buf.seek(0); buf.truncate(0)
        yield buf.getvalue()
    
    return Response(stream_with_context(gen()), 
                   mimetype="text/csv",
                   headers={"Content-Disposition": f"attachment; filename=customers_{account_id}.csv"})

@bp.route("/api/accounts/<int:account_id>/customers.csv")
def export_customers(account_id):
    def gen():
        buf = io.StringIO(); w = csv.writer(buf)
        w.writerow(["id", "name", "email"])
        q = (session.query(Customer)
             .filter(Customer.account_id == account_id)
             .order_by(Customer.id)
             .yield_per(BATCH))
